name: Scira
tagline: AI answer engine that searches the web and cites its sources.
description: Scira (formerly MiniPerplx) is an open-source, AI-powered answer engine — a Perplexity alternative built on the Vercel AI SDK. It plans a query, retrieves from the web, and returns concise answers with inline citations, drawing on 60+ models including Grok, Claude, Gemini, GPT, and DeepSeek. The AGPL-3.0 code is self-hostable, and a hosted app at scira.ai offers a free tier plus a Pro plan with connectors, memory, and voice.
insight: Began in 2023 as the open-source Perplexity clone 'MiniPerplx', was renamed Scira, and was picked for the 2025 Vercel AI Accelerator.
